Use case: historical-scene. First frame for a dark old-oil-painted cinematic in Swedish game Stormakt 3020 Episode II, 1536x1024. Wide view from the water approaching a desolate Swedish Baltic coast at dawn. A low ancient granite harbor is half swallowed by enormous ash roots and steep rough rock. A modest human-sized arched sea gate is visible at center-right below the cliff, ancient worn steps descend into black water. Crooked pines and bare ash branches silhouette the ridge. Morning mist veils the harbor, leaving hints of eroded sun-disc carvings in far stone. Massive natural roots crack the old retaining wall but remain believable natural wood, not tentacles. No houses, no modern quay equipment, no towers or castles, no ships or people in frame. Rich visible old oil painting brushwork throughout, matte umber granite, charcoal water, muted olive moss, cold grey sky; serious northern historical war drama. Moody and beautiful but readable, no luminous magic, no glossy CGI, no 3D render, no text or UI, no cute forms. Stable composition for subtle mist drifting and a slow camera approach later.
